title: Design A Stack With Increment Operation
description: Design a stack which supports push, pop, and increment elements at the bottom of the stack.
pseudocode:
1. push(val): if top < maxSize, stack[++top] = val
2. pop(): return top == -1 ? -1 : stack[top--]
3. increment(k, val): for i from 0 to min(k-1, top): stack[i] += val
